opinion.label: 意見論述
instructions: Write an answer to the QUESTION.
Give TWO reasons to explain your answer.

items.question: Do you think schools should teach students more about how to manage money?
Do you think children should help with housework every day?
Do you think students should be allowed to use smartphones during lunch breaks at school?
Is it a good idea for supermarkets to be open 24 hours a day?
Do you think it is better to get up early on weekends?
Do you think schools should give students more time for physical exercise?
Is it a good idea for students to take part in events in their local community?
Do you think people read fewer books today than in the past?
Is it a good idea for high school students to study abroad for a short time?
Do you think families should eat dinner together every day?

email.label: Eメール
instructions: You have received an email from a foreign acquaintance.
Write a reply email to the acquaintance.
In your reply, answer the question in the email.
Also ask TWO questions about the underlined part to learn more about it.

items.body:
Hi,

Guess what! My father bought me a [[new electric bicycle]] last month. Now I ride it to my part-time job every day. It is much faster than walking, and I don't get tired even when I go up hills. But it was expensive, so I have to take good care of it.

By the way, I want to know what you think. Do you think more people in your town should ride bicycles?

Your friend,
Olivia

Hi,

I have some news. I started a [[small vegetable garden]] on my balcony this spring. I water the plants every morning before school, and last week I picked my first tomatoes. They tasted better than the ones from the store!

My little sister wants to grow vegetables, too. Do you think it is good for children to grow vegetables at school?

Your friend,
Daniel

Hi,

Last month, I joined a [[cooking class for beginners]] at the community center near my house. We meet every Saturday, and the teacher shows us how to make easy dishes. Last week, we made curry, and I cooked it again for my family.

I think cooking is an important skill. Do you think young people should learn how to cook?

Your friend,
Sophie

Hi,

Last weekend, I took part in a [[beach cleanup event]] with some friends from my school. We found a lot of plastic bottles and bags on the beach. It was hard work, but I felt good after we finished.

My teacher says volunteer work is a good experience. Do you think all students should do volunteer work?

Your friend,
Jack

Hi,

I want to tell you about something new. I started using a [[language exchange app]] a few weeks ago. I can chat with people from other countries, and I teach them English while they teach me their language. It is a lot of fun.

I'm curious about your opinion. Do you think it is better to learn a foreign language online than at school?

Your friend,
Grace

Hi,

A [[bookstore with a café]] opened near my house last month. I often go there after school. I can read books while I drink hot chocolate, and there are always many people there on weekends.

My father says fewer people buy paper books these days. Do you think people will buy fewer paper books in the future?

Your friend,
Ryan
